chunks: And Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Ridha عليه السلام said:
"Indeed, between the two mountains of Tus is a handful taken from Paradise; whoever enters it will be safe from the Fire on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.آمِنًا: safe and secure, describing protection granted to the one who enters it
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, from which the entrant is protected
key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the heavenly origin of that blessed portion
key_terms.جَبَلَيْ طُوسَ: the two mountains of Tus, identifying the sacred location mentioned in the hadith
key_terms.قَبْضَةً: a handful or portion, indicating a small part taken from Paradise
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, the time at which this safety is manifested

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Jawad عليه السلام say about the sacred place between the two mountains of Tus?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Ridha عليه السلام describes a place between the two mountains of Tus as a portion taken from Paradise. The hadith emphasizes the sanctity and salvific merit associated with entering that blessed place, particularly safety from the Fire on the Day of Judgment.
